0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs, now 1-2 and 9th in the West, host the winless Sacramento Kings (0-2, 14th in the West) in the Spurs' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, and San Antonio is still looking for its first home win after taking its most recent game on the road. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The Spurs won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026, and this season's series has no games yet.
